title: Inotiv, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-07
summary: Inotiv, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 6, 2026 disclosing that its lenders granted a waiver of the minimum liquidity covenant under its Credit Agreement for two specific test dates (April 3 and April 10, 2026). The waiver was limited in scope and did not amend any other provisions of the Credit Agreement.
key_points: Inotiv, Inc. is a small-cap company (traded as NOTV on Nasdaq) based in West Lafayette, Indiana, operating in the research/biotech sector
Lenders granted a waiver of the minimum liquidity covenant for the April 3, 2026 liquidity test date
Lenders also granted a waiver for the April 10, 2026 liquidity test date
The waiver was limited to these two specific test dates only
No other provisions of the Credit Agreement were amended
The filing was signed by Beth A. Taylor, Chief Financial Officer
